items.title: JPMorgan grows wary on AI-exposed industrials, lowers price targets
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan said it has become far more cautious on industrial stocks tied to AI data center spending, with the bank starting Eaton (NYSE:ETN), Johnson Controls (NYSE:JCI) and Vertiv (NYSE:VRT) at Neutral and lowering the price targets on most of its other AI-linked names.

items.title: Oklo Rises 4% as DOE Clears Groves-1 Reactor for Unrestricted Operations: “Reset the Nuclear Industry’s Expectations”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo shares jumped 4% today after the Department of Energy cleared its Groves-1 test reactor for unrestricted operations. Groves-1 shows Oklo can build fast, but it still needs a cost for its first Aurora powerhouse and a binding customer.
